<reason>CON won the necessity clash. PRO showed pre-release checks are needed, but CON showed risk-based regulation can require independent verification, evidence submission, and preventive stop orders before launch. PRO never proved an affirmative yes adds safety beyond those tools, and its deadline concession allowing provisional launch undermined its own irreversibility/gate-necessity claim while leaving the incumbent-delay asymmetry unanswered.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON's Rebuttal 2 turn that PRO's provisional staged deployment after a missed deadline proves enforceable conditions can protect without completed clearance, collapsing PRO's only gate makes tools binding claim.</best_rebuttal>
